description:
Maximize your nursery floor space with the French Country Chest. This tall, graceful storage piece offers multiple dovetailed drawers in a vertical footprint that fits beautifully in smaller nurseries while providing surprising storage capacity.

Each drawer features smooth full-extension glides for easy access and dovetail construction for lasting durability. The solid wood frame with signature French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, brings warmth and character to your nursery. The top drawer is perfect for small essentials, while the larger lower drawers accommodate clothing, blankets, and more.

Non-toxic, baby-safe finish throughout.

If you would like help choosing a finish, confirming timing, or picturing how this piece fits your nursery plans, use Get Personal Assistance. We reply the same or next business day so you can decide with full information, at your own pace.
